cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit and supplies its composition, camera, and temporal structure.
Source caption: A woman in traditional Chinese attire is sitting and reading a book with a blue cover, while a man in similar attire is sitting beside her, seemingly engaged in a conversation.
<Subject 1> is the book with a blue cover in <Video 1>.
<Subject 2> is the woman and man in traditional attire in <Video 1>.
<Subject 3> is the surrounding scene in <Video 1>.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>.
Change the book with a blue cover to a red cover

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - Apply the edit requested in the summary; preserve its other source properties and actions.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - Preserve these source people and objects, including their appearance and actions.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - Preserve the remaining source scene and objects.
<Video 1> (composition, camera, and temporal structure): fully_preserved - Preserve the source framing, camera motion, cuts, and action timing.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A woman in traditional Chinese attire is sitting and reading a book with a red cover, while a man in similar attire is sitting beside her, seemingly engaged in a conversation.
The edited subject is <Subject 1>; the other source people and objects are <Subject 2>, and the remaining setting is <Subject 3>, as shown in <Video 1>.

overall_soundscape:
The benchmark specifies no audio edit.

non_diegetic_music:
The benchmark specifies no music edit.

cases.parent_semantics: R92/R88 numerical code, fresh same-host actual Native and selected forced; six conditions/raw AV noise/first6 AVx0 exact.

router.query_support: all spatial queries in each position bin overlapping valid physical time; pure-pad bins remain native

purpose: Blue book cover changed to red, preserving people and paper movement
condition_scope: Six actual Qwen/tag/reference/position clean condition blobs, AV noise and all20x0+final archives per run; same-source paired actual equality. No reference audio input.
source_event_annotations: Evaluation-only source observations. No hand-marked action window enters model or router.
cost: Record20NFE/20callbacks/1000blocks; Native0/ON450 routed blocks; capture time separate; no online observer.

evaluation.official: Original short0362 source/edit/target fields, complete short source
evaluation.visibility_policy: Reference event review plan is evaluation-only. No manually labelled event window enters attention or prompting.

acceleration_axes.weights: Same four checkpoint SHAs and nine core SHAs as prior H3 experiments
acceleration_axes.runtime: Host9 inheritedR120 runtime/core and unchanged six numerical files
acceleration_axes.attention: Native PyTorch SDPA via inherited audited block wrapper; H3 Sage patch absent
acceleration_axes.linear_backend: Triton INT8 with inherited row chunking guard
acceleration_axes.sampler: Euler20 manual shifted video sigmas12/audio3, CFG1
acceleration_axes.postprocessing: 65 valid frames at24fps; frames65..72 are repeated padding and excluded from evaluation. No interpolation.
acceleration_axes.snapshot_cost: 20 intermediate AV snapshots plus final per job; measure separately

first_pair: First actual root-selected guided pair only; no source is forced to guide.

screening.resume: No automatic resubmission or restart after release; preserve pending review.

prompt_protocol: Verbatim official source/edit/target fields in six-section Context-IR; same prompt for Native and forced
